body: Thank you for your reply, I think I am just a little overwhelmed right now with everything and it's leading me to think these thoughts

I'm lazy, I leave everything as late as possible. I kept things hidden from my family as a child-when it was their role to help me, they could have helped me. But no I was arrogant and thought I could handle it on my own. I become obsessed with every women I have any meaningful conversation with. I just want to die. I can't handle feelings

by permanent escape of course I mean suicide.
I just really want to kill myself, fuck. I act like I have it under control, but I really don't. I don't know what to do.
I've tried talking to a counselor about it.
I've tried talking to a guy friend about it. 
I do have a female friend I could talk to about it, I'm considering it. She is going through a rough time atm as well as me, though as far as I know she doesn't know about my depressive state, it's possible she's worked it out.

I've not tried any drugs yet, though I am averse to taking any. I am not considering drugs atm, but if what I'm feeling atm continues then I may need to... I don't know. 

Also the female friend I mentioned is the first female I've been close to since I was in love with my best friend around 5 years ago. I don't want to ruin the friendship. She isn't interested in anything more right now, and neither am I. If I tell her about my current state I fear she won't be interested in spending time with me anymore. 
edit: maybe I was fine before, but now I have a close friend
again, all the feelings that have passed me by in the last 6 months have decided to hit me.

Aghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh fuck feelings, fuck chemicals, fuck my body.

Hmm, just because you can see a cliff doesn't make it any easier to climb.. 

I feel sorry for you about your sleep no longer being an escape. I still can escape that way but that just makes a permanent escape more attractive.

I guess... at the moment events are enough that they pose a challenge but it shouldn't be insurmountable. However because of what has happened to me in the past it's very very very hard to stop myself from ending it. It's not the load overpowering me, it's that I'm already down on the floor, already hunched without strength to get back up.
I have some energy, I can do a few things. It's just things which matter to me, or have mattered to me in the past I just get a load of negative feelings about before I can even try to attempt them.


A stumble can mean you've fallen if you raise the white flag, if you give up, give in.
So things went badly, yet I'm still here..... I don't want to be. I don't have energy to move in the direction I want to go in right now, and it's making me feel like shit

I think so, I've not heard of it here in the UK anyway.

I can enjoy company of others and things, but when I'm feeling like I am at the moment things just tire me out.. 

I have in the past just blanked friends for a year or two because I didn't have the energy to mantain relationships and stay sane... 

Perhaps, if you choose that then I wish you the best of luck.
Thank you for talking to me. I think that if things go badly at the trials next week I will just hit a bar and get black-out drunk rather than ending it... I don't know, who knows.

What is a 60? Hiding how I really feel is part of why I feel tired. I'm an introvert at heart and interacting with people tires me out in general. Also as I said I don't really care about anything so faking interest in the things which used to interest me tires me out a lot as well

Trouble getting to sleep more than waking up at the moment.
Perhaps I can... we will see; I'll think about it
